reasoning: The claim is labelled proposed and its wording is conditional (If ... could ... would then), so there is no modal misreading. E1, the development record, gives the Special Draw Right and lineage crews carrying channel repair from Book 20; it states no outside apprentices and no training condition. The training condition comes only from E7, attributed agent_proposed, and E3 frames the need for demonstration as agent-proposed. As a proposal this is defensible; its premises are not record.
quote: The Special Draw Right is conditional on training apprentices from outside the lineage.
alternative_reading: Read as a conditional proposal, the development says that if outside apprentices are trained, a demonstration and a test of the Right's condition become possible. No quote was offered. The quote supplied is E7, which states the training condition only as agent-proposed text, so it does not make that condition record.
would_settle: An established source item stating that the Special Draw Right is conditional on training outside apprentices, or an author statement adopting that condition as canon.
creative_room: Lineage labour under the Right can be staged as strain; outside apprentices can be proposed as relief; the Right's condition can be tested as a story turn. Treat as proposals, not record: the training condition, the demonstration of repair, and the test outcome. Reframing the condition as not required remains open.

clauses.text: If outside apprentices are trained under the Special Draw Right
clauses.note: Hypothetical antecedent. E1 names lineage crews under the Right but no outside apprentices; E7 links the Right to outside apprentices only as agent-proposed.
A possibility, not an event, so the modal is not a misreading. E3 frames the need for demonstration as an agent inference.
Presupposes a training condition on the Right. Only E7 states it, attributed agent_proposed; E1 states no condition.
Conditional form. No test of the condition is described in the cited items.

defensible_possibility: A stage in which outside apprentices are trained under the Special Draw Right, their repair is demonstrated, and the Right's training condition is tested, presented explicitly as a proposed development rather than as record.
